cite: Paine v. Bergrose Development Corp., 119 Misc. 796

Foreclosure-sale/writ-of-assistance dispute over ownership of fixtures installed by a mortgage-era tenant; no letting/lodging/boarding issue.
Restrictive-covenant case ('but one dwelling') enjoining remodeling of a one-family house into upper/lower flats; concerns permanent two-family conversion, not short-term letting of rooms.

cite: People ex rel. Swedish Hospital in Brooklyn v. Leo, 120 Misc. 355

cite: New York Eye & Ear Infirmary v. Chrisomalis, 120 Misc. 437

notes: Certiorari over board of appeals allowing continuation of a sand-mining business in a residential zoning district; no letting/lodging issue.

Restrictive-covenant dispute over whether an attached garage is a prohibited 'barn' or 'outbuilding'; no letting/lodging issue.

notes: Trust accounting dispute over apportionment of a corporate stock dividend between capital and income; no real property letting/lodging issue.
